content.value: A certain stage of criminal investigation, the inspection in-charge is 60% convinced of the guilt of a certain suspect. Suppose that now a new piece of evidence that shows that the criminal has a certain characteristics (such as brown hair, baldness etc) is uncovered. If 20% of the population possesses this, how certain of the guilt of the suspect should the inspector now be if it turns out that the suspect is among this group?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2017
